mes_oee_daily.title: Hiệu suất vận hành & OEE theo máy (theo logic mesbcoee)
mes_oee_daily.notes: Chỉ số OEE tính cho máy có khai báo cycle_time và cavity; máy lắp ráp không có cycle_time trả NULL (chưa đủ căn cứ tính OEE).

base_select.availability_pct: round((CASE WHEN r.run_minutes > 0 THEN GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) * 100.0 / r.run_minutes END)::numeric, 2)
base_select.performance_pct: round((CASE WHEN GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) > 0 AND (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) > 0 THEN LEAST(100.0, (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) * 100.0 / GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)) END)::numeric, 2)
base_select.quality_pct: round((CASE WHEN (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) > 0 THEN r.ok_qty * 100.0 / (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) END)::numeric, 2)
base_select.oee_pct: round((CASE WHEN r.run_minutes > 0 AND GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) > 0 AND (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) > 0 AND (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) > 0 THEN (GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) * 100.0 / r.run_minutes) * LEAST(100.0, (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) * 100.0 / GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)) * (r.ok_qty * 100.0 / (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty)) / 10000.0 END)::numeric, 2)

base_subquery.sql: SELECT a.machine_code, a.create_date AS day, sum(coalesce(a.complete, 0)) AS ok_qty, sum(coalesce(a.ng, 0)) AS ng_qty, sum(CASE WHEN a.end_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date >= a.create_date AND a.end_date > '1900-01-01' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date::timestamp + a.end_time::time - a.create_date::timestamp - a.create_time::time)) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS run_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.complete, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS ok_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.ng, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS ng_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.skip_shot, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS skip_minutes FROM public.mes_oi_confirm a LEFT JOIN public.mes_scheduling_output s ON s.mes_scheduling_code = a.mes_scheduling_code AND s.product_code = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.dmhosokhuonsp k ON k.ma_khuon = s.mold_code AND k.ma_sp = a.product_code WHERE a.sp_chinh_yn = 1 GROUP BY a.machine_code, a.create_date

extra_joins: LEFT JOIN public.mflist_line l ON l.line_code = r.machine_code

LEFT JOIN (SELECT machine_code, create_date AS day, sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date::timestamp + end_time::time - create_date::timestamp - create_time::time)) / 60.0) AS stop_minutes FROM public.mes_oi_stop_line WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date >= create_date AND end_date > '1900-01-01' GROUP BY machine_code, create_date) st ON st.machine_code = r.machine_code AND st.day = r.day
